title: Harvest Load Log Form
subtitle: Harvest Load record recurring events, evidence, variances, review decisions, escalation, and accountable period closeout in one operational record.
description: An original, workflow-complete harvest load operating log covering identity and routing, domain observations and evidence, accountable decisions, exceptions and escalation, and completion handoff without replacing qualified judgment.
use_case: Use for a defined operating period when staff need repeatable entries, traceable observations, visible exceptions, and a reviewed handoff. The record is owned by the harvest and shipping owner and closes only after evidence, exceptions, disposition, and the next accountable handoff are documented.

sections.title: Harvest Load log routing
sections.guidance: Define the period, owner, subject, and controlling identifiers.

blocks.label: Operating Log identity and routing
blocks.guidance: Assign one owner and use the same record ID in attachments and follow-up.

blocks.label: Harvest Lot Or Outbound Load identity
blocks.guidance: Preserve the identifiers used by the controlling farm, facility, or partner record.

sections.title: Harvest Load operating context
sections.guidance: Capture the baseline needed to interpret recurring entries.

blocks.label: Entry readiness and record controls
items: Field, crop, harvest lot, and crew were recorded
Start, finish, and load departure times were captured
Container, pallet, bin, or package IDs were assigned
Count, gross, tare, and net measures were reconciled as applicable
Product condition and temperature were noted under the facility plan
Transport unit, seal, driver, and destination were recorded
Rejected, held, reworked, or diverted product remained identifiable
Harvest, packing, and shipping references were linked
blocks.guidance: Use these confirmations at the start of the log period and revisit changed conditions.

sections.title: Harvest Load recurring entries
sections.guidance: Record each event with enough evidence to reconstruct what occurred.

blocks.label: Harvest Load event log
blocks.guidance: Use one row per distinct event; continue under a linked record when more rows are needed.

blocks.label: Trend, context, and supporting evidence notes

fields.label: Harvest Load trend and evidence detail

sections.title: Harvest Load period review and decision
sections.guidance: Review completeness, trends, and work that cannot be closed.

blocks.label: Review evidence
items: Harvest Load entries, dates, and identifiers reconcile
Trends and abnormal events are supported by recorded evidence
Open exceptions have an owner and due point
Restrictions or holds are visible to the next operator
Qualified review was obtained where the controlling procedure requires it

blocks.label: Decision rationale, trend interpretation, and next action

sections.title: Harvest Load exceptions and escalation
sections.guidance: Make incomplete or abnormal events visible until disposition.

blocks.label: Stop, hold, and authority boundary
blocks.guidance: This form records harvest and load evidence; it does not certify product condition, food safety, weight, or transport suitability. Hold exceptions and route release or disposition to the authorized owner under applicable plans.

blocks.label: Harvest Load exception triggers
items: Field, lot, container, load, or seal identity mismatch
Count, weight, scale, or document discrepancy
Product condition, damage, or foreign-material concern
Temperature, cooling, delay, or capacity exception
Transport, destination, receiver, or route change
Held, rejected, diverted, or commingled product gap
blocks.guidance: Mark each applicable trigger and explain any uncertainty in the exception record.

blocks.label: Harvest Load unresolved-event register
blocks.guidance: Do not close a row until its disposition and accountable owner are explicit.

sections.title: Harvest Load log closeout and handoff
sections.guidance: Reconcile the period and transfer remaining work.

blocks.label: Harvest Load open actions and limitations
blocks.guidance: Carry forward every item that is not fully resolved at closeout.

blocks.label: Harvest Load handoff confirmations
items: Harvest Load entries and period totals were reconciled
Corrections and exception records retain accountable owners
Restrictions, holds, or service needs were transferred
Next log period or review point was assigned
Source records and supporting evidence were filed
blocks.guidance: Unchecked items remain part of the open handoff.

blocks.label: Final outcome, remaining limits, communications, and acceptance notes
